categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches were spurious substring keyword hits; the change modifies signing and PSBT processing, not peer-to-peer networking.
categories.rationale: The PR has no connection to P2P transport, peer management, or relay.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies SigningProvider and PSBT handling in descriptorprocesspsbt and utxoupdatepsbt.
categories.rationale: Fixes a privacy and metadata leak where MuSig2 aggregate pubkeys and participant BIP 32 derivation paths from unrelated descriptors were injected into PSBT inputs. The PR resolves issue #36323 by verifying aggregate pubkey involvement before attaching MuSig2 data to the PSBT.
